E1 discusses refractory Hf-Mo-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr alloys without Ni or precipitation, and E2 describes sigma-phase precipitation in Al-Nb-Ti-V with Ni/Co additions, not Ni3Ti. Thus, the key premises lack direct prior evidence.
